# Load libraries

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(biomaRt)
library(CellChat)
```



# Read in data

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_RNAseq <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/tumours_bulk_RNAseq/GSE80678_LLC_tumour_counts.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


# Make vector describing the experimental conditions and add to metadata (Sample Table)

```{r, include=FALSE}
# 1. Prepare counts matrix
LLC_counts <- LLC_tumour_RNAseq[, c("LLC_1", "LLC_2")]   # extract only the sample columns

# Set rownames to gene IDs
rownames(LLC_counts) <- LLC_tumour_RNAseq$gene_id

# 2. Define sample metadata
sample_table <- data.frame(
  sample_name = colnames(LLC_counts),
  condition   = factor(rep("LLC", ncol(LLC_counts)))
)
```



# Calculate TPM

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Make sure counts are numeric
LLC_counts <- as.matrix(LLC_counts)
storage.mode(LLC_counts) <- "numeric"



# 2. Gene lengths (in base pairs)
# Connect to Ensembl
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

# Get gene lengths for your genes
gene_ids <- LLC_tumour_RNAseq$gene_id

gene_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "start_position", "end_position"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = gene_ids,
  mart = ensembl
)

# Calculate gene lengths in base pairs
gene_info$length <- gene_info$end_position - gene_info$start_position + 1

# Make a vector of lengths in the same order as your counts matrix
lengths_kb <- gene_info$length[match(rownames(LLC_counts), gene_info$ensembl_gene_id)] / 1000

LLC_counts <- LLC_counts[!is.na(lengths_kb), ]
lengths_kb <- lengths_kb[!is.na(lengths_kb)]



# 3. Compute RPK (Reads Per Kilobase)
LLC_rpk <- LLC_counts / lengths_kb



# 4. Compute TPM
LLC_TPM <- apply(LLC_rpk, 2, function(x) (x / sum(x)) * 1e6)



# 5. Check results
head(LLC_TPM)
colSums(LLC_TPM)  # each column should sum to ~1e6
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(LLC_counts, gene_info, LLC_tumour_RNAseq, LLC_rpk, sample_table, gene_ids, lengths_kb)
```



# Get list of genes for "Secreted" proteins from Human Protein Atlas, then map to mouse orthologs

## Filter secreted protein list from HPA
### NOTE - I downloaded a list of HPA.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/proteinatlas.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hpa_secreted <- hpa[grepl("Secreted proteins|Predicted secreted proteins", hpa$Protein.class), ]

# Human secreted gene list
hpa_secreted_genes <- hpa_secreted$Ensembl
```


## Map human genes to mouse orthologs
### NOTE - I downloaded a file from BioMart that converted human genes to mouse orthologs

```{r, include=FALSE}
orthologs <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/human_to_mouse_orthologs.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "", fill = TRUE)

# Subset for orthology_confidence = 1 (high confidence of gene mapping)
orthologs <- orthologs[orthologs$orthology_confidence == 1, ]

# Filter orthologs for human secreted proteins
orthologs_secreted <- orthologs[orthologs$human_gene_id %in% hpa_secreted_genes, ]

# Filter orthologs for mouse genes
LLC_secreted_ids <- unique(orthologs_secreted$mouse_gene_id)
```


## Filter TPM for secreted genes, then for TPM > 0

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_TPM_secreted <- LLC_TPM[rownames(LLC_TPM) %in% LLC_secreted_ids, ]

LLC_TPM_secreted <- LLC_TPM_secreted[rowSums(LLC_TPM_secreted > 0) == ncol(LLC_TPM_secreted), ]
```


## Add in gene names and make rownames

```{r, include=FALSE}
gene_symbols <- mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = rownames(LLC_TPM_secreted),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
)

LLC_TPM_secreted <- as.data.frame(LLC_TPM_secreted)

LLC_TPM_secreted$gene_symbol <- gene_symbols[rownames(LLC_TPM_secreted)]
```


## Get a list of genes secreted by LLC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_secreted_genes <- LLC_TPM_secreted$gene_symbol
```

```{r, inlcude=FALSE}
write.table(LLC_secreted_genes, 
            file = "LLC_secreted_genes.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```



# Get list of matching receptors for secreted genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the built-in mouse ligand-receptor database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse

# Subset the interactions table for ligands in your secreted gene list
lr_LLC <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction, ligand %in% LLC_secreted_genes)

# Extract receptors that line up with secreted genes
LLC_receptors <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(lr_LLC$receptor.symbol, ","))))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.table(LLC_receptors, 
            file = "LLC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```
